population: 225 candidates retained; existing155-species provider-excluded panel;191004 heldout rows
models: Refit B5 natural geography and J1 natural plus transport using unchanged original random-forest settings. Reuse only exact matching existing M5 and T1 provider-excluded predictions.
response: Probability of one or more records in10 recording days after largest-provider removal; verify hypergeometric response against days and successes before fitting.
evaluation: Same2011-2014 predictors/2015-2018 training response and2015-2018 predictors/2019-2022 evaluation response; full supported155-species sample; secondary strict-island summaries explicitly labeled.
limits: Provider removal changes effort and response, not all historical geography inputs or the original candidate domain. Historical-distance features, static host catalogue, coastline, DSM and port features retained. Not full provider-independent reconstruction, not spatial/species sensitivity. No tuning or outcome-selected species. Absolute errors across different observation panels are not causal effects.
